subject: Finalize: MAP, eval plan & signature cadence for Acme Data
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rebecca Shaw <rebecca.shaw@acmedata.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + evaluation plan for pilot — please review

Hi Rebecca —

Quick follow-up from our call this morning. I attached the latest mutual action plan (Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx) and an updated evaluation plan (Acme_EvalPlan_v2.docx). Key asks in this email:

- Confirm the proposed 3-week pilot window (Jan 10–31) and whether you need an earlier start.
- Flag any procurement or legal gating items we should surface now (SOC2 evidence, retention terms).
- Let us know if your dev team prefers a dedicated test model or hosted sandbox for the eval.

What's new in this version: simplified approval ladder (Procure -> Legal -> IT) and an optional early-access start if you can sign before Jan 4.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx, Acme_EvalPlan_v2.docx

Thanks — happy to hop on another 15-min call to run through the plan.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
From: Rebecca Shaw <rebecca.shaw@acmedata.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Data - Procurement <procurement@acmedata.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation plan for pilot — please review

Monica —

Thanks for sending. Quick notes from procurement and IT:

- Procurement: estimate timeline for purchase order process is ~2 weeks after receipt of final SOW. We will need vendor W‑9 and insurance certificate.
- IT: can run in your hosted sandbox for the eval; they asked about data residency — will you confirm EU data never touched? (Acme's EU customers ask this).

We are amenable to Jan 10 start but request a final SOW by Dec 20 so internal budget owners can sign off by Dec 31.

I'll loop back with exact PO owner; cc'd procurement.

Best,
Rebecca
Head of Data Partnerships, Acme Data Inc
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rebecca Shaw <rebecca.shaw@acmedata.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing & timeline — SOW ready for review

Hi Rebecca —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Per procurement notes, Monica and I condensed pricing into a single-page summary and generated the SOW draft (attached). Highlights:

- Pilot: 3 weeks, $6k flat fee (credit toward first month if converted).
- Production baseline: reserved capacity estimate included in SOW; flexible ramp.
- Deliverables: MAP milestones, evaluation success criteria, and a proposed start date of Jan 10.

Attachments: Acme_SOW_draft.pdf (we will push final after legal redlines).

If procurement can accept the PO timeline (2 weeks after final SOW), the Dec 20 SOW target Rebecca mentioned should keep us on track for a Jan 10 launch. We can also start a short concierge onboarding on Jan 4 if you secure early sign-off.

DocuSign link (preview): https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/12345

Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & timeline — SOW ready for review (internal legal notes)

Team —

I reviewed the SOW draft. Main legal items for redline:

1) Data residency statement — we should add explicit language that Acme's EU customer data will not be exported from EU when requested (we can offer a contractual commit to data segmentation for the eval).
2) Limitation of liability — propose cap at 3x fees for pilot only; procurement may try to lower but that's standard.
3) Termination for convenience — add 30-day notice for pilot termination to avoid sticky commitments.

I'll attach a redline by EOD Dec 20. If procurement needs insurance/COI, we have templates to share.

-Laur a
VP, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rebecca Shaw <rebecca.shaw@acmedata.com>, Acme Data - Procurement <procurement@acmedata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: FINAL: SOW + MAP (redlines applied) — sign window & start date confirmation

Rebecca / Team —

Attached is the FINAL SOW (Acme_SOW_final.pdf) and an updated MAP reflecting Laura's redlines. Summary of logistics and next steps so everyone is aligned:

- Sign window: Dec 27–30 (DocuSign envelope ready). If countersigned by Dec 30, we will lock Jan 10 as pilot start.
- Attachments: Acme_SOW_final.pdf (redlines applied), Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx (updated approval ladder), docusign-envelope-12345.pdf (envelope summary).
- Required from Acme: executed SOW, PO (within 2 weeks of SOW), vendor W‑9, and COI (insurance).
- Onboarding: Camila will run a 2-hour kickoff on Jan 5 for engineers if paperwork done early; otherwise, Jan 11 for the longer ramp.

Please review and sign the DocuSign envelope. If procurement needs a seeded email to the PO approver, happy to provide.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

—Monica
From: Rebecca Shaw <rebecca.shaw@acmedata.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Data - Procurement <procurement@acmedata.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FINAL: SOW + MAP (redlines applied) — sign window & start date confirmation

Monica / Ben —

Good news — I routed the envelope this morning to the budget owner and legal. PO owner confirmed availability to issue PO the week of Jan 4 assuming the SOW is countersigned by Dec 30. I signed the DocuSign envelope at 16:20; legal will complete countersign early tomorrow.

Confirming: target pilot start remains Jan 10. I will upload the W‑9 and COI to your procurement contact once legal signs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get this live.

Rebecca
